## AccrualVault.getNetApy() method

The MetaMorpho vault's experienced Annual Percentage Yield (APY) weighted-averaged over its market deposits, after deducting the performance fee, if interest was to be accrued on each market at the given timestamp.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getNetApy(timestamp?: BigIntish): number;
```
